decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (DPA-69799-01 Rev A received 03/01/2013, Design & access statement, EA flood risk assessment, 1127/PL.01 Rev A, 1127/PL.02 Rev A, 1127/PL.03 Rev A received 07/01/2013, 1127/PL.04 Rev B and 1127/PL.05 Rev B received 13/02/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the two storey side extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the ground floor rear extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with DPA-69799-01 Rev A. The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority
description: Erection of a two-storey side extension, ground floor rear extension and erection of new front porch.  With the installation of 2x roof windows to the front elevation and new chimney to the side extension.
